non_claims: The C-glycosylation position (6-C versus 8-C) is not claimed; the published intensity-ratio criteria for it depend on collision energy and instrument
Sugar identity (hexose versus pentose), unit counts and the aglycone formula come from the chosen hypothesis and are not claimed

The aglycone skeleton rests on the precondition's flavonoid formula list, which isobaric non-flavonoid aglycones can share (for example aloe-emodin anthrone, C15H12O4, in aloin); anthrone C-glycosides are listed as a competitor
That both sugars are C-linked is not claimed; the motif is the class with at least one C-glycosyl unit

notes: Protonated 6,8-di-C-glycosyl flavones give an aglycone ion carrying residues of both C-sugars (+C4H4O2, +C3H2O or +C2) with a 0,2X+ loss of one C-sugar, with or without water, while Y0 stays weak.

competitors.note: Flavonoid O-glycosides share compositions with C-glycosides (apigenin 7-O-glucoside and vitexin are both C21H20O10) and lose whole sugars to a strong Y0.

source.locator: pp. 1839-1841 (Results: aglycone ion of C-glycosides; di-C-glycoside in lemon juice); Table 4; Fig. 5
Sec. IV.D, p. 8 (schaftoside and isoschaftoside, positive ions)

source.reference: WS8-P3 protocol default floor, fixed before any data look (directive 2026-11-18; P2 default 0.01); kept where no paper prints a floor, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author)

terms.note: [(0,2X)(0,2X)]+ = [aglycone+H+C4H4O2]+, 6.6 % at 20 eV and 22.7 % at 40 eV for a 6,8-di-C-glucoside (QqQ); Xb+ under in-source CID
[(0,2X)(0,1X)]+ = [aglycone+H+C3H2O]+, 71 % for an isoschaftoside standard (QTOF) and the 40 eV base peak of a 6,8-di-C-glucoside (QqQ)
[(0,1X)(0,1X)]+ = [aglycone+2C+H]+, 42 % for an isoschaftoside standard (QTOF) and 43.8 % at 40 eV for a 6,8-di-C-glucoside (QqQ)
Xa+, 0,2X+ loss of a C-hexose (C4H8O4, 120) from [M+H]+; also 44 % at 20 eV in a QqQ di-C-glucoside table
0,2X+ loss of a C-pentose (C3H6O3, 90) from [M+H]+, reported for the C-6-pentosyl isomer of hexosyl-pentosyl di-C-glycosides
0,2X+ loss of one C-sugar with water: C4H10O5 (138) for Hex, C3H8O4 (108) for Pen; both printed for an isoschaftoside standard
Y0 [aglycone+H]+, much weaker in C-glycosides than in O-glycosides and not listed for the di-C-glucoside at 20 or 40 eV
